attributes.title: Designing JSON:API responses
attributes.excerpt: Shape list and detail payloads so KViews can hydrate relationships from included.
attributes.content: KViews expects a JSON:API document with data, optional included, and meta for pagination. Relationships reference other resources by type and id; included carries the nested author rows used in templates as {{author.name}}.

attributes.title: Templates without a build step
attributes.excerpt: Use {{title}} in the row template — attributes are flattened for Handlebars.
attributes.content: Item.getRenderContext() exposes attributes at the top level and nests related resources, so list rows stay simple while still supporting {{author.name}} and {{#each tags}} patterns.

attributes.title: Adapters: JSON:API and plain REST
attributes.excerpt: Swap wire formats with adapter: 'jsonapi' or adapter: 'plain' without changing views.
attributes.content: The adapter layer parses HTTP responses and serializes updates. This demo uses the default JSON:API adapter with static JSON files in docs/examples/.

attributes.title: Draft: pagination notes
attributes.excerpt: Paging needs a live API — static JSON always returns the full list.
attributes.content: For a local demo, reload the collection or append rows client-side. Hook up a real backend when you want page[offset] queries to return different slices.
